# 阈下的差别：交换随识时，形成依存而不观察的储量上的差别保持到两网的支持分岔；观察储量解除它，他者回应储量本身时则不然 / Differences below the threshold: where the exchange follows registration, a difference in a stock a formation depends on and does not observe stays until the two webs' support diverges; observing the stock lifts it, and others responding to the stock itself break it

## 主张 Claim

设两个流在形成 g 所识（依存或观察）的每个条件上逐步平衡，并且 g 周围的交换随其识：凡 g 直到某步识得相同，两个流跨过该步在 g 所识的每个条件上，对在场的全部形成，取用与给予的总量相同（Flow.ExchangeFollows）。那么 g 识得相同期间，它所识条件上的每个差别都保持起始的样子（Flow.difference_kept）。第二个网在 g 所识的条件上起始不低、在其观察的条件上相同时，在第一个网此前每步都支持 g 的每一步，g 都识得相同（Flow.alike_while_supported），可以有任意多个条件不同；差别在某步之前已改变，必有更早的一步，第二个网的水平接纳 g 而第一个网不支持它，活动需要支持时 g 在第一个网中并非此前每步都活跃（Flow.difference_changes_after_divergence）。起始只在 g 依存而不观察的一个储量上不同、第二个网中高 d 时，在第一个网此前每步都支持 g 的每一步，储量恰好高 d，g 所识的其余条件相同，g 此前每步都识得相同（Flow.subthreshold_alike）；第一个网每步都支持 g 时每步都如此（Flow.subthreshold_alike_always）。见证：SupportDrawn 中形成需要一个单位、在每个被支持的步取一个单位，交换只随支持，差别保持到第三步，较低的网在第三步不支持它而较高的网支持，第四步差别已变（SupportDrawn.difference_waits）；JointFailure 中两网从第二步起都不支持形成，差别每步都保持（JointFailure.difference_kept）；Gauged 中观察储量的形成在第一步取尽需要之上的全部，在较高的网中动用了差别，交换随其识而不约束任何东西，只识支持时交换不随其识（Gauged.gauge_changes_difference）；储量划作自身的立着时，量度自身就是量度储量（Gauged.own_is_stock）；Attracting 中被较高的储量招来的取用者使较高的网在第二步就不支持依存者，交换不随其识（Attracting.higher_breaks_first）；SelfPrey 中以所需一依存于自身的猎物，咬一个单位经支持每步都识得相同，量度自身在第二步识之，咬两个单位经支持在第二步就被识（SelfPrey.threshold_on_oneself）。不用 Lean 公理。 / Let two flows balance at each step on every condition a formation g registers (depends on or observes), and let the exchange around g follow its registration: wherever g has registered alike up to a step, the two flows take from and give to every condition g registers alike across that step, in total over every formation present (Flow.ExchangeFollows). Then while g registers alike every difference on a condition it registers stays as it was at the start (Flow.difference_kept). Where the second web starts at least as high on what g registers and alike on what it observes, g registers alike at every step before which the first web supported it (Flow.alike_while_supported), any number of conditions differing; where a difference has changed by a step, at some earlier step the second web's levels admitted g and the first web did not support it, and where activity needs support g was not active in the first web at every earlier step (Flow.difference_changes_after_divergence). Where the starts differ only in one stock g depends on and does not observe, d higher in the second web, at every step before which the first web supported g at every step the stock stands exactly d higher, every other condition g registers stands alike and g has registered alike (Flow.subthreshold_alike), and at every step where the first web supports g at every step (Flow.subthreshold_alike_always). Witnesses: in SupportDrawn a formation needing one unit draws one unit at each supported step, the exchange following its support only; the difference stands through the third step, where the lower web fails to support it and the higher supports it, and has changed by the fourth (SupportDrawn.difference_waits); in JointFailure both webs fail the formation from the second step and the difference stands at every step (JointFailure.difference_kept); in Gauged a formation observing its stock draws all of it above its need at the first step and draws on the difference in the higher web, the exchange following its registration constraining nothing, while through support only the exchange does not follow its registration (Gauged.gauge_changes_difference); carving the stock as its own standing, a gauge of oneself is the gauge of the stock (Gauged.own_is_stock); in Attracting a taker drawn by the higher stock makes the higher web fail the dependent at the second step, the exchange not following its registration (Attracting.higher_breaks_first); in SelfPrey, with the prey depending on its own standing at need one, a bite of one registers alike through support at every step and through a gauge of oneself at the second, and a bite of two registers through support at the second step (SelfPrey.threshold_on_oneself). No Lean axiom is used.

## 前提与对应 Hypotheses and correspondence

- 平衡只在被识的条件上逐步假设（Flow.BalancesOn，单元素家族，不需要有限性）；整体的平衡经 Flow.Balances.on 给出它。 / Balance is assumed only on the conditions registered, at each step (Flow.BalancesOn, singleton families, needing no finiteness); global balance gives it through Flow.Balances.on.
- 交换随识（Flow.ExchangeFollows）是给出的假设，不由动力学推出：它是关于 g 周围全部交换的，排除他者对 g 所不识者作出回应；Attracting 是它不成立时的反例。 / The exchange following registration (Flow.ExchangeFollows) is a supplied hypothesis, not derived from the dynamics: it concerns the whole exchange around g and excludes others responding to what g does not register; Attracting is the counterexample where it fails.
- 识：形成识它的支持（水平是否接纳它）与它所观察之条件的水平（obs，参数，基础是 supportOnly）。活动由表示给出，不算作被识；在 Web.Dependent 之下它不能超出支持。 / Registration: a formation registers its support (whether the levels admit it) and the levels of the conditions it observes (obs, a parameter, with supportOnly the base). Activity is supplied by the representation and is not counted as registered; under Web.Dependent it cannot outrun support.
- 见证的结论：各见证的流与网（SupportDrawn、JointFailure、Gauged、Attracting、SelfPrey）。 / For the witnesses: their flows and webs (SupportDrawn, JointFailure, Gauged, Attracting, SelfPrey).
- 离散的步（从第 0 步计）；自然数的水平、所需与数量；条件上的判定相等（DecidableEq）只在按条件分情形处使用，不用经典推理。 / Discrete steps, counted from step 0; natural-number levels, needs and amounts; decidable equality of conditions (DecidableEq) is used only to split cases on conditions, and no classical reasoning is used.

Ren 的提议：“can becoming provide wisdoms to avoid run away feedbacks and the identification of knowledge, learning, and scientific principles like falsifiability”，“I think all the wisdoms about wisdoms, how to think, learn, update, are all explained within what we have, if not not proved yet”。AI 的回答提出反馈的三种不见、失控是在其一之中运行的回路、跨过它们的方式、可否证性是被展开纠正的条件，以及 理 的读法；Ren 答：“agree with you, great job, start now. for 4, you can explore which option is better, then make decision”。独立审查收窄了这些读法：三种不见各有其范围（阈下在交换随识之处，视界之外在延续开放之处，识闭包之外在成员只经自己之识回应之处）；失控的读法是启发，不是陈述；理 读作对识负责的模型。所以记录中的读法是 AI 收窄之后的，待 Ren，不是 Ren 所接受的原文。第 4 问（形成自身的立着是否算作被识）由 AI 探索后决定：基础只识支持（supportOnly），一类读法中自身的立着经承担自身（Web.SelfBearing）作为阈值被识，量度自身（ownStanding）是观察前提；理由见整合文档 §70.1。“识”（registers）原作“计入”，与 P42 一致；Ren 认为“计入 is apparently weird, need better word”，AI 先改为“反映”，Ren 定为“识”（“for registers, use 识”），取差别在形成的状态中显出之义（见整合文档 §{SEC}.2）。 / Ren's proposal: “can becoming provide wisdoms to avoid run away feedbacks and the identification of knowledge, learning, and scientific principles like falsifiability”, and “I think all the wisdoms about wisdoms, how to think, learn, update, are all explained within what we have, if not not proved yet”. The AI's answer proposed three blindnesses of feedback, a runaway as a loop running inside one of them, the ways across them, falsifiability as the condition of being corrected by the unfolding, and a reading of 理; Ren answered “agree with you, great job, start now. for 4, you can explore which option is better, then make decision”. The independent review narrowed the readings: each blindness has its scope (below a threshold where the exchange follows registration, beyond the horizon where the continuation is open, beyond the registration closure where the members respond only through their own registration); the runaway reading is a heuristic, not a statement; and 理 is read as a model answerable to registration. So the readings recorded here are the AI's narrowed ones, pending Ren, not the wording Ren accepted. Question 4, whether a formation's own standing counts as registered, was decided by the AI after exploring the options: the base registers support only (supportOnly); in the one-kind reading own standing registers through self-bearing (Web.SelfBearing) as a threshold; and a gauge of oneself (ownStanding) is an observation premise. The reasons are in §70.1 of the integration note. The Chinese for “registers” was 计入, as in P42; Ren found it “apparently weird” and asked for a better word, the AI proposed 反映, and Ren chose 识 (“for registers, use 识”): a difference showing in the formation's state (§70.2 of the integration note).
